maria_cs: quick note 1 Lumina onboarding is hitting short 429 blips immediately after SDK session init. customer runs a parallel smoke that spins ~18 inits.
ben_engineer: any log excerpt from their side?
maria_cs: they sent this sanitized snippet: 
```
INFO session.create -> 200
INFO emit x-session-meta: v1;env=staging;session=tok123
WARN POST /v1/complete -> 429 (rate_limit)
```
maria_cs: they say it shows up within 500-1200ms of session create.
jess_sre: sounds like a connection-shard hotspot. if our edge hashing accidentally used x-session-meta or a value derived from it, identical concurrent values will collide.
ben_engineer: we rolled an LB config last week that added a few headers to the hash input for perf testing; possible drift included the telemetry field.
lucas_infra: can you paste a sanitized header block (tenant id ok to include)?
maria_cs: sample headers from Lumina: 
```
:method: POST
:user-agent: lumina-sdk/1.0.0-alpha
:content-type: application/json
x-session-meta: v1;env=staging;session=tok123
x-tenant-id: lumina-xyz
```
jess_sre: 18 concurrent with the same session-meta pattern = likely routed to the same upstream. the upstream per-conn limiter trips, producing 429s for a short window.
ben_engineer: mitigation options: (A) quick infra: tenant-scoped edge rule to remove x-session-meta from the consistent-hash key for lumina-xyz, canary first; (B) SDK: release small patch (1.0.1-alpha) so init path omits x-session-meta and sends it later with jitter; (C) ask customer to lower concurrent inits for 30-60m.
lucas_infra: I can scope the edge rule to x-tenant-id: lumina-xyz and timebox it (24h). will canary to 5% of the tenant traffic then scale to 100% if metrics look normal.
maria_cs: Lumina wants the fastest path so they'd prefer the infra canary. I'll confirm they can pause wide-parallel tests during canary.
jess_sre: safety checklist: 1) tenant scope required 2) auto-expire rule in 24h 3) watch per-upstream queue and error budget spikes 4) have rollback plan.
ben_engineer: I'll draft SDK change and push to our staging package feed. release note: "1.0.1-alpha: defer telemetry header from blocking init; reduces init-side fanout." ETA ~90m.
lucas_infra: opening PR-6120 for edge rule, will queue canary deploy. ops-bot: enqueue job.
ops-bot: deploy job queued for PR-6120 (canary=5%).
maria_cs: scheduled 20m sync with Lumina in 25m and asked them to reduce parallel inits to <=6 until canary stabilizes.
jess_sre: recap action items: lucas_infra -> PR-6120 canary deploy (5% -> 100%) ; ben_engineer -> SDK 1.0.1-alpha patch to defer x-session-meta ; maria_cs -> coordinate with Lumina and paste post-canary traces here.
maria_cs: thanks all 1 will update thread after call and include any failing request IDs. :thumbsup:
